keyword: education department calculation changes make public service loan forgiveness harder for borrowers

verifications.claim: The SAVE plan has been eliminated.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'following the elimination of the SAVE plan', 'Department of Education eliminated the SAVE'; R2: 'SAVE plan, which was officially blocked'; R6: 'elimination of the SAVE plan', 'termination of the SAVE'; R7: 'SAVE Plan has ended', 'defunct SAVE Plan'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state or imply the SAVE plan has been eliminated, ended, or blocked, making it unavailable.

verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'eliminated the SAVE'; R2: 'blocked by a federal appeals court'; R6: 'elimination... termination'; R7: 'SAVE Plan has ended', 'defunct'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently describe SAVE as eliminated, ended, terminated, or blocked/defunct, directly contradicting 'suspended' which implies temporary pause rather than permanent removal.

verifications.claim: Borrowers can no longer use lower, subsidized payments from the suspended SAVE plan to calculate their PSLF buyback payments.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'will not be able to use their lower payments on SAVE'; R2: 'won't use the SAVE plan formula', 'SAVE... came with much lower monthly payments'; R6: 'will not be able to use their lower payment formula from the now-defunct SAVE plan'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly support inability to use lower SAVE payments for buybacks; 'subsidized' is interpretive but aligns with 'lower'; 'suspended' not used but context of unavailability matches.

verifications.claim: PSLF buybacks are used to turn non-qualifying months into qualifying ones.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '"buy back" any months spent in deferment or forbearance'; R2: 'retroactively pay for any months they missed because of a forbearance or deferment'; R3: 'retroactively pay for any months they missed'; R6: 'buyback option... periods of forbearance or deferment, allowing them to retroactively make payments'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe buybacks as retroactively paying for non-qualifying (deferment/forbearance) months to count toward PSLF qualification.

verifications.claim: The Department of Education is requesting new income and family size documentation for buyback calculations made on or after July 1, 2024, if the borrower was not already on an IBR, PAYE, or ICR plan.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'on or after July 1, 2024... "If the borrower was not on the IBR, PAYE, or ICR Plan... then we will request income and family size information"'; R6: 'for buyback calculations on or after July 1, 2024, if a borrower was not on an IBR, PAYE, or ICR plan, their income and family size information will be requested'
verifications.reasoning: Exact match in wording and details from sources.

verifications.claim: There are over 88,000 pending PSLF applications as of Feb 2026.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: '88,170 PSLF buyback applications are pending as of February 28'; R2: 'More than 88,000 borrowers are waiting... on their application'; R6: 'as of February 28, 2026, there were 88,170 pending PSLF buyback applications'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm >88,000 pending as of Feb (2026 context), but specify 'PSLF buyback applications', not general 'PSLF applications'; number and date match buyback context.

verifications.claim: There is a new Tiered Standard Plan.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R7: 'the new Tiered Standard Plan that will be available beginning July 1'; 'new Tiered Standard Plan will offer fixed terms – 10, 15, 20, or 25 years'
verifications.reasoning: Source directly announces and describes the new Tiered Standard Plan.

verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'canceled after 120 payments, or 10 years'; R3: 'canceled after 120 payments, or 10 years'; R4: 'forgiveness after 10 years of payments'; R5: 'cancellation after 10-25 years' (context PSLF 10); R6: '120-month requirement'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state PSLF requires 120 qualifying payments (10 years).
